# Acts of Thomas — Chapter 10
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Source:** Syriac MS / Greek recension, Acts of Thomas 10

---

*[Thomas continues his mission. Conversions, miracles. Mygdonia renounces her husband.]*

1. And when Thomas had finished the hymn, he went into the city again and found Judas Mygdonia on the road.

2. She asked him: "Where have you been, man of God? For I have been seeking you."

3. And Thomas said to her: "I was singing a song to my Lord. But now tell me what you want."

4. And Mygdonia said: "My husband Charisius is troubled because of you, for he has heard that I have forsaken him and have received instruction from you. And I beg you — go away from this city, lest he harm you."

5. And Thomas said to her: "Fear not. My Lord Jesus Christ who commands me will protect me. But go to your husband, and be gentle with him."

6. And Mygdonia said: "But I cannot return to him, for I have received the seal of the Lord."

7. And Thomas said: "The seal of the Lord is holy and pure; and those who receive it and keep it shall be holy with him."

8. And she went away to her house.

9. And Charisius her husband was waiting for her and was exceedingly angry, and he said to her: "Where have you been and who has seduced you from me?"

10. And Mygdonia said: "I have not been seduced. I have heard about eternal life, and I believed."

11. And Charisius said: "What is this eternal life and what is this teaching that you have received?"

12. And Mygdonia said: "It is not a thing that can be described in words. But if you desire to hear, come with me and listen."

13. But Charisius was angry and would not hear, and he sent word to Thomas that he should come to him.

14. And Thomas came and Charisius said to him: "Why have you led my wife astray? And why has she forsaken the bed of our marriage?"

15. And Thomas said: "I have not led her astray. But she has received the gift of God."

16. "What gift?" said Charisius.

17. Thomas said: "She has received the Holy Spirit, who is not bound by the things of this world."

18. And Charisius was angered and said to the king: "This stranger has bewitched my wife."

19. And the king said: "Take the man and put him in prison and let us see what will come of this matter."

20. And Thomas was led to prison and gave thanks to God.

---
*EMET note: Mygdonia's refusal to return to her husband's bed is the ATH's central marital-asceticism plot. The ATH consistently presents sexual renunciation within marriage as a higher calling — a position that made it controversial in antiquity and remains so. "Received the seal of the Lord" = baptism.*
